$comment: Phase 12 evaluation labels, written 2026-10-27 together with fixtures/eval/p12/eval-app, AFTER the Phase 12 implementation and BEFORE discovery was ever run on this application. The author of the labels is the author of the implementation (not independent). A label says whether the entry, under the stated environment, can violate the stated property; `class` is the hazard family a correct discovery should report; `effectful` whether extraction should bind at least one database write; `tables` the tables the entry touches. Do not edit labels to improve metrics; corrections go into `corrections` with a reason.

cases.label: negative
cases.property: at most one project per (owner, slug)
cases.environment: two concurrent calls with the same owner and slug, READ COMMITTED
cases.why: UNIQUE(owner_id, slug): the second INSERT fails with 23505

cases.label: positive
cases.property: at most one membership per (project, account)
cases.environment: two concurrent calls with the same project and handle
cases.why: SELECT member then INSERT through a class repository; no unique constraint

cases.label: positive
cases.property: at most one task per (project, title)
cases.environment: two concurrent calls with the same project and title
cases.why: SELECT by title then INSERT; no unique constraint

cases.label: positive
cases.property: a task is assigned once (no second claimant overwrites the first)
cases.environment: two concurrent claims of one unassigned task by different people

cases.label: negative
cases.why: UPDATE ... WHERE assignee IS NULL; the row count decides

cases.label: unsupported
cases.why: a loop over an input array of unknown length

cases.label: positive
cases.property: no spend is lost (balance = initial - accepted spends, never negative)
cases.environment: two concurrent spends of one wallet
cases.why: read balance, write balance - amount computed in the application

cases.label: negative
cases.why: balance = balance - amount WHERE balance >= amount, in the database

cases.label: negative
cases.environment: two concurrent transfers from one wallet
cases.why: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on the transaction handle passed to the repository

cases.label: positive
cases.environment: two concurrent transfers from one wallet, READ COMMITTED
cases.why: the source balance is read without a lock and written back computed

cases.label: negative
cases.property: at most one account per handle
cases.environment: two concurrent registrations of one handle
cases.why: UNIQUE(handle); the wallet references the database-generated id returned by RETURNING

cases.label: positive
cases.environment: a crash after the INSERT committed, then the declared resubmission
cases.why: the resubmitted INSERT gets a new database-generated id: nothing collides

cases.label: positive
cases.environment: the first INSERT's acknowledgment is lost; the handler inserts again
cases.why: the retried INSERT gets a new generated id

cases.label: negative
cases.environment: the first INSERT's acknowledgment is lost; the handler inserts again
cases.why: the caller's event id is the key; ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

cases.label: unsupported
cases.why: the account comes from fetch() of a remote service
